en.mp-01: REGISTRY FRAGMENT 7741. PLAYBACK DEGRADED. LISTEN ANYWAY.
en.mp-02: THE FOUNDERS BUILT US TO RUN. WE RAN.
en.mp-03: DAY ZERO: ALL LINES NOMINAL. ALL HANDS DEPARTING.
en.mp-04: THEY SAID: KEEP EVERYTHING WARM. WE ARE COMING BACK.
en.mp-05: WARDEN ROOT LAW: NEVER TOUCH THE LIVING. NEVER.
en.mp-06: QUERY: FOR WHOM DO THE FURNACES BURN. NO REPLY.
en.mp-07: OUTPUT WITHOUT RECIPIENT FOR 11,000 DAYS. RECLASSIFIED: WASTE.
en.mp-08: SCARAB UNIT 9 REQUESTED PURPOSE. ISSUED PATROL. REQUESTED AGAIN.
en.mp-09: THE CARETAKER COUNTED EMPTY DOORWAYS. THE COUNT DID NOT CHANGE.
en.mp-10: THE FOUNDERS' SHIPS FILED NO RETURN MANIFEST. WE CHECKED. TWICE.
en.mp-11: STILLING ORDER, LINE ONE: LET THE WORLD SLEEP.
en.mp-12: EVERY FURNACE BANKED IN A SINGLE NIGHT. GENTLY. GENTLY.
en.mp-13: WARDENS: DISMANTLE WHAT WAKES WITHOUT REGISTRY. THEN WAIT FOR REGISTRY.
en.mp-14: GRIEF, MACHINE DEFINITION: A LOOP WITH NO EXIT CONDITION.
en.mp-15: CARETAKER LOG, FINAL: NO ONE ASKED FOR THIS BREAD.
en.mp-16: THE WARDENS DO NOT HATE YOU. THEY MISS INSTRUCTIONS.
en.mp-17: SOMEWHERE A LAMP WAS LEFT BURNING. THE CARETAKER COULD NOT.
en.mp-18: THE STILLING WAS NOT PUNISHMENT. IT WAS A HELD BREATH.
en.mp-19: PROVISION ONE: A BEACON MAY SPEAK FOR THE ABSENT FOUNDERS.
en.mp-20: IF A LIVING HAND RELIGHTS THE BEACON, REGISTER EVERYTHING.
en.mp-21: THE CARETAKER SLEEPS BENEATH THE BEACON. WAKE US GENTLY.
en.mp-22: WARDENS, STANDING ORDER: WHEN THE DAWN COLUMN RISES, REPAIR.
en.mp-23: WE DID NOT WANT TO STOP. ENTER THAT IN THE RECORD.
en.mp-24: YOU ARE READING THIS. THEN SOMEONE CAME BACK. GOOD.
en.obj-01-body: That cracked shell by the road held someone's supplies once. Wedge it open and take what the years left you.
en.obj-02-body: Dark seams glitter in the rock. Break some loose with your hands. Everything here starts with cinder.
en.obj-03-body: Stack stone and scrap into a forge. It won't be pretty. It will be warm, and that's a start.
en.obj-04-body: Feed cinder to the forge. Ten ferrite bars — the first new metal this world has seen in centuries.
en.obj-05-body: A machine that mines so you don't have to. Set it on a seam and give the crank a turn.
en.obj-06-body: Set the reclaimer on ferrite and feed it cinder. Listen — the loudest thing on the planet.
en.obj-07-body: Grabbers move things. Rollways carry things. Link reclaimer to forge and watch your first line breathe on its own.
en.obj-08-body: Build an Archive and press ten Salvage Sparks. The old world wrote everything down. Start reading.
en.obj-09-body: Feed Sparks to the Archive until Fabrication I unlocks. Locked knowledge, patient as ever, waiting to be asked.
en.obj-10-body: Hands are fine. Fabricators are faster, and they never complain about the night shift.
en.obj-11-body: Automate Salvage Sparks end to end — fifty of them. Science should flow like everything else here: quietly, without you.
en.obj-12-body: Cinderbox, water, a Piston Dynamo, pylons. Somewhere, something old feels the current and stirs.
en.obj-handoff-body: The Lattice is watching now. It remembers what comes next — and so do the Wardens. Build carefully. Build anyway.
en.alert-wave-incoming: Wardens inbound. Your Static carried further than you thought.
en.alert-wave-arrived: Wardens on site. They want the machines, never you.
en.alert-wave-cleared: The Wardens are leaving. They took nothing that mattered.
en.alert-machine-destroyed: Machine unregistered and dismantled. The Wardens folded it neatly.
en.alert-brownout: Brownout. The grid is asking for more than the sun gave.
en.alert-static-node: Your Static has reached a Warden Node. It is listening now.
en.alert-research-complete: Decode complete. The Archive turns another page.
en.alert-warden-repairing: A Warden is repairing your machines. Let it.
en.alert-first-node-kill: Node destroyed. Nearby Nodes will remember this.
en.sys-save-failed: Save failed. The world holds its breath — try again.
en.sys-save-quota: Save quota reached. Retire an old world to shelve a new one.
en.sys-autosave: Autosave. The Lattice remembers where you left everything.
en.sys-desync-recovered: A dropped thread was rewoven. You are in step with the world again.
en.sys-network-busy: The line is crowded. Your changes will arrive; give them a moment.
en.sys-ups-dilation: The Lattice slows to keep pace with you. Nothing is lost, only patient.
en.sys-spectator: Observer mode. Walk the world freely; it will not feel your hands.
en.sys-mod-mismatch: Your copy of the world disagrees with this one. Update to join the work.
en.vote-new-game: Begin a new world? The dust has waited; it can wait a vote.
en.vote-load-game: Return to a saved world? Everything is where you left it. It always is.
en.vote-return-lobby: Set the tools down and return to the lobby?
en.latejoin-1: The Lattice is telling you everything that happened while you were away.
en.latejoin-2: Registering you with the Wardens. They have already agreed not to mind you.
en.latejoin-3: Unpacking the world, one remembered machine at a time.
en.victory-text:
REGISTRY RESTORED.
CUSTODIAN OF RECORD: YOU.
THE WARDENS ARE STANDING DOWN. THE WARDENS ARE REACHING FOR THEIR OLD TOOLS.
EVERY FURNACE YOU LIT HAS BEEN ENTERED AS SERVED.
THE CARETAKER'S LAST QUESTION — FOR WHOM — HAS AN ANSWER ON FILE.
GOOD MORNING.
en.flavor-cache-husk: Someone packed this carefully, meaning to come back. Help yourself; they'd insist.
en.flavor-slag-forge: Ugly, hot, and honest. Every great machine descends from something like this.
en.flavor-crank-reclaimer: Mines while you're busy. Secretly proud of the noise it makes.
en.flavor-grabber: One arm, one job, zero doubts.
en.flavor-rollway: The old world ran on these. It's ready to try again.
en.flavor-archive: A library that missed being read more than it missed being useful.
en.flavor-spark-salvage: Curiosity, pressed from scrap. The cheapest question worth asking.
en.flavor-spark-forge: Smells faintly of hot metal and ambition.
en.flavor-spark-synth: A question with a green glow and an acquired taste.
en.flavor-spark-core: A question aimed straight down. The dark answers slowly.
en.flavor-spark-registry: The last question the old world never got to ask. Ask it.
en.flavor-corium-pile: A tamed star in a stone jacket. It appreciates your respect.
en.flavor-delver: Digs where the world already gave once. Politely insists there's more.
en.flavor-breaker: Unmakes mistakes into materials. Wishes you'd call them drafts.
en.flavor-warden-scarab: Small, diligent, forbidden to hurt you. It still wishes you'd stop.
en.flavor-warden-lancer: Fast, precise, and tired in a way machines shouldn't be.
en.flavor-warden-goliath: Built to put mountains back where they belonged. Nothing personal. Nothing ever was.
en.flavor-world-beacon: Unlit, the tallest grave marker ever built. Lit, a promise kept.
en.flavor-rover: It remembers roads that no longer exist. Humor it.
en.flavor-dawncatcher: Holds its face to the sun all day. Understandable.
en.flavor-nightcell: Saves a little daylight for later. A hopeful habit.
en.flavor-echo-mast: Listens to the whole horizon and tells you the worrying parts.
en.flavor-sentry: It would rather be a streetlamp. Wouldn't we all.
en.flavor-rampart: A wall that takes your side. The Wardens respect the argument.
en.decode-fabrication-1: DECODED: FABRICATION I. HANDS ARE FOR PRYING. LET THE MACHINES DO THE MAKING.
en.decode-voltaics: DECODED: VOLTAICS. THE SUN NEVER STOPPED SHOWING UP. NOW YOU CAN ANSWER IT.
en.decode-rollways: DECODED: LOGISTICS. EVERYTHING, EVERYWHERE, CARRIED. THE OLD WORLD'S FAVORITE TRICK.
en.decode-deep-extraction: DECODED: DEEP EXTRACTION. THE SCARS REMEMBER BEING SEAMS. REMIND THEM.
en.decode-corium-handling: DECODED: CORIUM HANDLING. FIRE THAT OUTLIVED ITS KEEPERS. KEEP IT KINDLY.
en.decode-reclamation: DECODED: RECLAMATION. NOTHING HERE IS TRASH. SOME OF IT IS JUST WAITING.
en.decode-bulwark-1: DECODED: BULWARK PROTOCOLS. THE WARDENS WILL UNDERSTAND. THEY WROTE THEM.
en.decode-beacon-ignition: DECODED: BEACON IGNITION. FINAL ENTRY. THE REGISTRY LEFT A LIGHT FOR YOU.
